gen-archivo-black-gf-major-mono-display: Archivo Black has a lowercase that fills the middle of the line and leaves generous room around each letter. And Major Mono Display, a monospace body, answers with thin neon-tube strokes whose curves sweep open, like glowing thread against the heavy heading.
gen-archivo-black-gf-martian-mono: Archivo Black stamps down thick, low-slung letters with plenty of space around each one, giving the heading an urban weight. Martian Mono, a monospace, runs loose and wide.
gen-archivo-black-gf-spline-sans-mono: Archivo Black hits hard with a lowercase that fills the line and a confident, city-street authority. But Spline Sans Mono, a monospace, is the one that holds up in text, its bold fixed-width letters keeping lowercase close to capital height.
gen-archivo-black-gf-victor-mono: Victor Mono reads loose and structured, with bowls left open on one side. Its strokes carry no shift from thick to thin, so a long stretch of text moves along in a steady, spacious line under the heavy Archivo Black heading.
gen-audiowide-fs-amulya: Futuristic and a bit techy, Audiowide leads with tall lowercase. Its tile-like letters make the statement, while Amulya, a plain sans, does the quieter job of staying readable through its generous, open curves.
gen-audiowide-fs-chillax: Audiowide sets the tone with letters like spaced-out tiles, drawn as if with one marker tip. Chillax loosens things up, its spaghetti-like lines and unfinished loops giving a longer passage a casual, relaxed pace.
gen-audiowide-fs-plein: Audiowide draws everything as if ink were poured at one width, and its lowercase stands tall. Plein, a plain sans, brings reliability, with a clear channel leading into each round letter and a lower lowercase.
gen-audiowide-fs-roundo: Futuristic and a little showy, Audiowide sets tall lowercase letters like tiles with wide grout lines. And Roundo, a sans-serif, keeps its small counters unclogged, with an n whose arch and stem match.
gen-audiowide-fs-spline-sans: Audiowide has no thick-thin shift at all, so its tall, tile-like letters look traced with one marker tip. Spline Sans, a sans-serif, keeps a longer passage approachable, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-audiowide-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink, clean and dependable. Audiowide supplies the futuristic edge, with tall lowercase and tile-like letters, and that gap in lowercase height is the pair's strongest quality.
